They can’t bark” (web:Isa.56.10) -- who instead say “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.” (web:Isa.56.12), a quoted boast that closes the indictment. The row keeps the reflection that follows, הַצַּדִּ֣יק אָבָ֔ד (byte tier) (oshb:Isa.57.1, byte tier) -- “The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart.” (web:Isa.57.1) -- inside the same row rather than opening a fresh unit there: no vocative or frame marker intervenes between web:Isa.56.12 and web:Isa.57.1, and the reflection reads as the complex’s own closing register shift (from satire to lament) rather than a new address.
